narrative.intro: Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C has $2.3B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C has 7 awards this fiscal year and an average award size of $329M. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C obligations are up 1171.5% year over year. The Department of Homeland Security accounted for $2.2B of FY2026 obligations to Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C, while the Department of Defense accounted for $98.6M. Historic obligations for Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C show smaller annual totals in prior years: FY21 totaled $259M, FY22 totaled $168M, FY23 totaled $195M, FY24 totaled $54.5M, and FY25 totaled $181M. Current-year totals for Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C are partial, covering fiscal year to date, and the reported award-values in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than current-year obligations. Use these figures for budgeting, capture planning, or vendor analysis when engaging with Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C and its top buying agencies.
